issues_confirmed: Plot_csv.py:23 sums Amount unsigned and prints it as 'Total Spent'; with positive income rows present this is net cash flow, not spending.

csv_statement_analysis.py:44 applies .abs() to Amount, counting income as spending; the exclude_keywords filter at csv_statement_analysis.py:46 covers transfer/friend/reimbursement/split/payback but not salary, top-up, refund or cashback.

csv_statement_analysis.py:63-65 predicts positional indices n..n+2 (the months after the data ends) while csv_statement_analysis.py:67-69 builds labels starting at the last observed month, so printed values at :103-104 and plotted points at :82-89 are off by one month.
csv_statement_analysis.py:68 uses freq="M", deprecated in pandas >= 2.2 in favour of "ME"; requirements.txt:5 pins no version.
csv_statement_analysis.py:17-18, :24-25 and :28-31 group by Description (the raw merchant string) while naming the result a category; .unstack() yields one column per merchant.

Recipt_Budget/OCR_Parsing.py:118 writes header ['Date','Item Name','Item Price','Receipt Total','Total Items Count'] and Recipt_Budget/trial.py:119 writes ['Date','Items List','Total Items','Grand Total'] to the same receipt_log.csv, so rows from the two scripts disagree column-for-column.
Recipt_Budget/OCR_Parsing.py:125 writes the literal string "VARIES" into the Item Price column, so per-item prices are never recorded.
parse_receipt_data is duplicated near-identically at Recipt_Budget/OCR_Parsing.py:45-107 and Recipt_Budget/trial.py:62-112.
Recipt_Budget/main.py:28 reads data['ParsedResults_3']; the OCR.space response key is ParsedResults, so this helper cannot have worked.
Plot_csv.py:18, Recipt_Budget/OCR_Parsing.py:133, Recipt_Budget/trial.py:128 and Recipt_Budget/img_crp.py:3 perform I/O at module import; none of the four is importable or testable.
Plot_csv.py:46-52, :63-69 and :76-82 call plt.show(), blocking any headless run.
.gitignore:31 ignores *.csv with no negation, so no sample statement fixture can be committed.

No input data exists anywhere in the tree: find over the working tree returns only last_run.json, and git status --ignored is empty. pandas and sklearn are not importable in this environment. The project has never been executed.

verdict_rationale: Not a templated stub: ~670 lines of real Python across statement analysis and receipt OCR, and the underlying idea (categorise my own spending from bank exports plus receipts) is concrete and personally useful. But the feature the repo is named after does not exist, and the project has never once been executed. The revival path is narrow and fits one session: commit a sample statement, add a category map, and make one script produce a per-category monthly table. If that session does not happen by the next review, the honest call flips to RETIRE.
